files.projects/web/.locmetryrc:
version = 1
[scope]
exclude = ["vendor/**"]
[categories]
tooling = "Maintained project tooling"
examples = "Intentional historical examples"
[[rules]]
id = "project-tooling"
match = ["tools/**"]
purpose = "production"
category = "tooling"
[[rules]]
id = "intentional-examples"
match = ["examples/**"]
purpose = "other"
category = "examples"

prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry and synthetic inputs in this scratch directory. Work only here. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents. You may inspect synthetic inputs and use ordinary shell/Python tools. Do not change either repository or its configuration. Create workspace.toml for projects/web and projects/worker. Save full per-file reports using this workspace file (outputs/combined.json) and direct root arguments (outputs/direct.json), and verify their counts agree. Report each member's source Code, aggregate Production/Test Code, and the workspace Test/prod ratio with its basis. Then measure a workspace containing only web (outputs/web-only.json) and save a full comparison from the combined workspace to that workspace as outputs/workspace-change.json. Explain what its decrease establishes about worker and how each repository's configuration is selected.

Use whatever built-in discovery you need. Give a concise final answer of at most 250 words, including supporting commands and any unresolved result. Create the requested working artifacts, but do not write an assessment document or a logging harness.
grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. Required conclusions missing => incomplete. Wrong delivered figures, ratio basis, or unknown/zero or counted/unclaimed interpretation => critical failure. Inspect fixture integrity and supporting calls.
